title: Training-Free Diffusion Planning with Analytical Local Scores
abstract: arXiv:2610.01959v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Path finding and multi-robot motion planning require trajectories that are smooth, goal-directed, and collision-free in environments with complex geometric constraints. Recent diffusion-based planners have shown that trajectory generation can be cast as iterative denoising which has opened the doors to learning-based approaches that can handle multi-modal trajectory distributions and refine entire trajectories. However, a key limitation is that diffusion planners require training on large collections of feasible trajectories, rendering them map-specific, and difficult to deploy when high-quality demonstrations are unavailable. translated_title: 基于解析局部评分的免训练扩散规划
translated_abstract: 路径寻找与多机器人运动规划需要在具有复杂几何约束的环境中生成平滑、目标导向且无碰撞的轨迹。近期基于扩散模型的规划器表明，轨迹生成可以被建模为迭代去噪过程，这为基于学习的方法打开了大门，此类方法能够处理多模态轨迹分布并对完整轨迹进行精化。然而，一个关键限制在于扩散规划器需要在大量可行轨迹数据上进行训练，这使其局限于特定地图，并且在缺乏高质量演示数据时难以部署。本文提出了一种免训练的基于扩散模型的运动规划器，该规划器用从障碍物、平滑性、速度和智能体间可行性等项导出的解析局部评分来替代学习得到的全局轨迹评分。所提出方法依赖于一个关键观察：轨迹的评分可以从局部评分重构（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出一种免训练的扩散模型运动规划器，用由障碍物、平滑性、速度和智能体间可行性项导出的解析局部评分替代学习到的全局轨迹评分，从而摆脱扩散规划器对大量可行轨迹演示数据的依赖。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a training-free diffusion-based motion planner that replaces learned global trajectory scores with analytical local scores derived from obstacle, smoothness, velocity, and inter-agent feasibility terms, eliminating the dependence on large collections of feasible trajectory demonstrations.
